paraphrase: Each of the four seats (west, east, north, south) has its monastery, name-suffixes of its renouncers, deity, Veda and great saying; the renouncers of each seat follow its rule.

checks.note: Located in the eBhāratī Maṭhāmnāyopaniṣat (Ebharati-9567, Deccan College). It covers the four seats by direction with their names, deities and the great sayings (tattvamasi, ahaṃ brahmāsmi, ayam ātmā …). This summary-level entry was not checked section by section.
